title: Festbiss – Video-Ad 8 (DE) · „Die 60-Tage-Challenge“ – Langfassung mit Alltagsszenen
format: Long cut of Ad 7: same doctor, same restaurant/home scenes and 3D jaw-ridge models up to 0:58, then a fast montage of denture wearers eating everything (breakfast, park, restaurants, family dinners) with the doctor as a small cut-out picture-in-picture in the lower left; product end frame.
voice_note: Male VO (the doctor), German, calm, confident, direct. Address: Sie.
captions_note: Small white rounded boxes with black bold text, 2–4 words, centered just below the middle. Red header box with white text at the top in S01–S03; big white capitals in S03; doctor picture-in-picture lower left from S25 to the end; green round 60-day badge in S59.
